items.title: Difference between DNA Replication in Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Difference between DNA Replication in Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes: a main subheading of 19.3.3 Mechanism of DNA Replication, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 128-129.

blocks.text: Jagah (location): prokaryotes mein replication cytoplasm mein hoti hai (kyun ke un mein nucleus nahin). Eukaryotes mein DNA replication nucleus mein hoti hai.
Polymerases: prokaryotes mein DNA polymerase I, II aur III replication mein kaam karte hain. Eukaryotes mein kam az kam 14 polymerases hain (jaise alpha, delta aur epsilon).

Initiation aur termination sites: prokaryotes ke DNA mein aik hi origin site aur aik hi termination site hoti hai. Eukaryotes mein har chromosome par kai origin aur termination sites hoti hain aur replication har origin site par aik saath (simultaneously) shuru hoti hai. Is liye har chromosome mein kai replicons hote hain.
Okazaki fragments: prokaryotes mein Okazaki fragments lambe hote hain (1000 se 2000 nucleotides). Eukaryotes mein chhote hote hain (100 se 200 nucleotides).

Raftaar (speed): prokaryotes apna chhota DNA bohat jaldi copy kar lete hain. Eukaryotes ke paas linear (seedha) DNA bohat zyada miqdar mein hota hai. Is kami ko poora karne ke liye eukaryotes aik hi chromosome par hazaron mukhtalif origin sites se aik saath replication shuru karte hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text:
Biotechnologists DNA replication ko nayi technologies mein istemal karte hain, maslan:
• Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) mein scientists replication kar ke kisi khaas DNA ki arbon copies banate hain.
• Recombinant DNA technology mein scientists mukhtalif zaraye se DNA kaatte hain, phir replication se DNA molecules ki tadaad barhate (amplify karte) hain.
• Genome sequencing mein replication se genome ki bohat si copies banti hain, phir un ka sequence parha jata hai.
• Tashkhees (diagnostic studies) mein mareez ke DNA ke khaas hisse copy kar ke un mein tabdeeliyan ya mutations dhoondi jati hain taa ke genetic bimari ka pata chale.
